# Vendored WhiteUI 0.6.0

Fono installs the original published `@whitelife-core/ui-kit@0.6.0` tarball
from [whitelife-core-ui-kit-0.6.0.tgz](whitelife-core-ui-kit-0.6.0.tgz). No npm
credentials or separate package download are needed for this dependency. The
package is not a workspace or a rebuild: exports, generated distribution files,
styles and package metadata are unchanged.

- Original source tag: `v0.6.0`, commit `2fa5232000ab20349e35703ffd8fe7f5a0188167`.
- SHA256: `e0aabc07070a54eae56cfb810f120b3ebdcb12f34e1313a1eecc073c5dfaab65`.
- Original compressed size: 134150 bytes; 95 files.
- Per-file hashes, original registry URL and SHA512 integrity are recorded in
  [provenance.json](provenance.json). Eight source blobs were compared; generated
  distribution files were not rebuilt from the tag.

The original package declares MIT but contains no standalone LICENSE/copyright
notice. On 2026-10-17 the owner authorized vendoring this exact version and
explicitly deferred that missing text to a later library version. This snapshot
adds no invented copyright, does not apply Fono's license to WhiteUI, and does
not silently upgrade the dependency. Review the notice when an authorized
WhiteUI update is proposed.

Run `npm run test:release` to check the archive hash, package source and
anonymous CI contract. Updating this archive requires an explicit dependency
review and synchronized package/lock/provenance changes.
